name: shortlark
description: Shortlark: AI clipping SaaS. Express API, React web app and pre-rendered React landing page.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,web,landing -c yellow,cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web" "npm run dev -w landing"
scripts.build: npm run build -w server && npm run build -w web && npm run build -w landing
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w web && npm run typecheck -w landing
